title: Microsoft Sam fails at Tech Support
description: [Originally published on December 27, 2015]  I guess Microsoft Sam's not so good at Tech Support either... This is my final video that originally used Windows Movie Maker.  Watch on VidLii: https://www.vidlii.com/watch?v=pCyDGZ7Z8n1  Rags 2 Riches Rag by Audionautix is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution license (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) Artist: http://audionautix.com/  Hustle by Kevin MacLeod is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution license (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) Source: http://incompetech.com/music/royalty-free/index.html?isrc=USUAN1100793 Artist: http://incompetech.com/  Video Number: 74 [30] Series: MSfailsat Installment: 3 Original Render Date: 12/27/2015, 12:36 PM Re-render Date: 9/25/2017, 1:46 AM --END OF DESCRIPTION--

asr.full_text: A Few Days Later Drum dee-drum dee-drum dee-drum dee-drum. Sam... There you are. I need your assistance. Oh hey Mike. What do you need me for? Also, what's up with your voice?! I was assisting those who were seeking assistance through my tech support company, Fix the Computer Technology. Someone sent me an email seeming to be inquiring for assistance with their computer, but it was actually an email from a virus designer. And when I opened the email, I an email from a virus designer, and when I opened the email, I got infected with the virus. My immunity anti-virus system is trying to remove the virus but I will remain infected for the remainder of today. In simpler terms, I am sick and cannot continue working. I need you to be a substitute until my immunity anti-virus system cures the virus. Wait... ...why can't Mary Fillian, for you? I don't know even the first thing of tech support? The virus is contagious, so Mary is also infected. In fact, you better keep your distance from me to prevent being infected with the virus. Now, I'm going to the bedroom and turning to Safe Mode. If you need help search the computers help files. I wish you the best of luck. Okay get well soon. Oh by the way guys, Safe Mode to us is basically like going to sleep, since only the core drivers like the operating system are active, meaning we can't move around. Anyways, I better make my way to fix a computer technology. Hello, I'm Microsoft's fan... ...Microsoft Mike's older brother. I'm filling in for him, since he's sick. Okay. Microsoft Mike's office number is 137. Okay. I'll go there right away. When the phone rings... ...pick up the phone and answer the caller's blad blad blad blad blad blad blad. Boring instructions! I don't need to read the instructions. Oh boy. My first caller! Hello, this is Microsoft Sam of Fix-it Computer Technologies. How may I help you? I, I have a problem with my computer. It's literally running slower than a snail, covered in molasses. How can I make it go faster? Simple. Just give your snail a bath. inside. You know, that actually might work. Thanks for the help. You're welcome. Thank you for calling Fix-A-Computer Technologies. Oh boy, another caller. Sup, this is the epic Microsoft Sam who is working at Fix-A-Computer Technologies. How might I fix a computer? Ham ham ham ham. That was a lame joke. Anyways, I need some help with my computer. My son was downloading stuff on the internet and now all kinds of advertisements are popping up. I don't know what to do. How do I stop all these ass? POD is the provider of the ads. Hang on, let me go check. It says they're powered by Cinema Plus 4.5V. In that case, grab your safety torch and incinerate those rascals. But I don't have a safety torch. Then do you have some kind of gun? Ah, a pellet gun. That'll do. Thank you so much. No prob. Thanks for calling Fix-A-Computer Technologies. That oughta teach him for calling my awesome Poem's Lane. Oh goodness, another caller. Hi, I'm Microsoft's fan of Fix-A-Computer Technologies. What's the problem Hi I'm Microsoft Sam of Fix-A-Computer Technologies, what's the problem? Hi Sam. Wait, rain or mercer's copy? Yep, that's me. What are you doing here? A virus infected some of the files in my system32 folder. What do I do to get rid of the virus? That's easy, just move the entire system32 folder to your antivirus's coruntime. Oh really? I'll do that right naaa- Good grief. They just keep coming. When do I get a break? Hey! This is Microsoft's Wama Ficsa Computer Technologies! Where we give you answers to trivial questions you can't solve yourself! How may I debut today? Someone sent me a piece of Pi through cyberspace! It's at my computer desk right now. Why shouldn't I go with it? Eat it! It's free pie, dude! Thanks. So that's who my Pi from Thanksgiving lost said to. Another caller! I want a break already hello this is microsoft's fam filling in for my sick brother who works for a generic tech support company which doesn't like to let me have a break why is it this is the lily police good grief not you again answer my question when you are going to the living jail fine what's your question our computer is running very slow we can't patrol the place that the computer is slower than Windows 1.0 How do I make the computer go faster close it out the window? Your computer should be going faster from there. I don't think that will work trust me I tried it before and it sure does work fine is a good for you. I supposed it will work for us. Good bye! I never said the computer worked afterwards, ham ham ham ham. Hi, I am Microsoft Sam, who just wants a break from all of this madness. WhadaBawwhat? My computer won't work on at all. Please help. Okay, how old is your computer? That's kind of a weird question to ask. Not whenever computer is are involved. So how old is your computer? It's 20 years old. I bought it on the day Windows 95 released then your computer dead. What! Impossible. I always took good care of this thing Then maybe your computer got infected with CIH. What is CIH? Is it a type of poison? No, it's a virus that overwrites the BIOS. You could buy a new mother board but I would recommend just getting a new computer. Oh, okay. Same to you. No problem. Thank you for calling fixacomputertechnology. Wow, I'm surprised that actually went well. Eik, not again. Hey, this is Microsoft's Sam, who's about to quit his job at fixacomputertechnologies because they want me to answer boring questions 24x7. How can I give you a headache today? I need help with hacking your company. What is your password? Simple. It's incorrect. Since we're back at memorizing passwords, we get reminded every time we type in the wrong password. Pretty useful feature, if I do say so myself. Hey, he hung up on me! How rude of him to not say thank you! That's it, after I answer this guy's question, I'm getting outta here. Hello this is BlandblankblannaBlandblankblankblankblankblan Technologies! How may I not help you today? Hello, this is your boss. Oh hi boss! Can I have a break for crying out loud? You are NOT getting a break, because you are fired. What? I'm fired? Yes, you are fired. I've been hearing numerous complaints from our customers. One customer told me that you urged him to put his computer in water, and that ruined his computer. Another customer said that you told him to shoot some adware advertisements with the pellet gun, and that ruined his computer another customer said you told him to do some adware advertisement with a pellet gun and that ruined his computer screen i was most shocked to hear the Livy Police filing a complaint about you telling them to throw their computer out the window to make it go faster and now the want you in Livy jail need i say it again? you're fired but what about Mike's job? oh, don't you worry about Mike his job is fine. We can survive a day without his assistance Now, get out of my workplace before I call the Livvy Police on you. My locomotive goes OOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO The End Chugga Chugga
